findings.challenge: MockDstIO.stat() does not resolve symlinks — statImpl(isLstat=false) only checks this.files, not the symlinks map. When a path exists only as a symlink entry (via addSymlink) with no corresponding file entry, stat() throws ENOENT instead of following the symlink to the target file's stats, which differs from real filesystem behavior.

DependencyManager.createNode() has two code paths for publication status: (a) DstIO-aware path (lines 256-269) re-reads file content and manually parses metadata via MetadataManager.parseMetadata/validateMetadata, duplicating logic that already exists in MetadataManager.getPublicationStatus/getPublicationInfo (non-DstIO path, lines 270-274). Creates maintenance divergence risk as metadata rules evolve.
